facts.fact: The Council of Ministers on 22 April 2026 authorised a mission with a specialist firm to start a digital, geolocated, participatory addressing system first in Abomey-Calavi, Cotonou, Ouidah, Porto-Novo, Sèmè-Podji and Parakou, under a national addressing strategy.

systems.system: national street and door addressing system (planned)
systems.owner: Ministère du Cadre de Vie et des Transports; ANAT
